user.title: Connect to Grafana Loki
user.description: Enter the Loki server base URL (not the Grafana web UI URL). The integration only reads/query logs.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Loki
reauth_confirm.description: Your Loki credentials were rejected. Enter the current credentials for this Loki server.

data.token: Bearer token (leave empty to keep existing)

error.invalid_configuration: Invalid URL, authentication settings, or missing credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not contact the Loki query API.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication was denied by Loki or its proxy.
error.invalid_response: Loki returned an invalid response; check the server base URL.
error.server_changed: Reauthentication must use the existing Loki URL. Use Reconfigure to change servers.
error.already_configured: That Loki URL is already configured.

abort.already_configured: That Loki server is already configured.

settings.title: Polling and label mapping
settings.description: Built-in counters use Loki detected_level by default, matching Grafana dashboard v1.5. Indexed severity mode retains the old label-based behavior; the indexed label and value fields only affect that mode.

data.level_label: Indexed severity label name (indexed mode only)

add_metric.title: Add a numeric LogQL sensor
add_metric.description: Enter a LogQL instant metric query that returns one numeric value. For example: vector(42).

error.invalid_labels: Label names or severity values are invalid.
error.duplicate_or_empty: Query and sensor name must be provided, and the name must be unique.
error.invalid_query: Loki did not accept the query.
error.not_numeric: The query must return a scalar or exactly one vector series. Use sum() to aggregate multiple series.
